\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgfmath}
% one call site, three expressions over an unknown count: the strip
% call that keeps the expression text has the same key for all three.
\newcount\cnt \cnt=\pdfuniformdeviate 9
\def\f#1{\pgfmathparse{#1}\let\r\pgfmathresult}
\begin{document}
\f{\the\cnt+1}\f{\the\cnt+2}\f{\the\cnt+3}
\f{max(\the\cnt,10)}
\ifdim\r pt=10pt \gdef\ok{}\else\gdef\WRONG{}\fi
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
